mapper.sql: FROM teaching_registration_profile p JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.del_flag = 0 AND p.identity IN ('student', 'teacher') AND u.username NOT IN ('demo', 'admin') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code IN ('admin', 'dev', 'demo') )
